mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a weakening demand cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) signals labor market tightness that fuels inflation and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5% AND PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (base 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a central bank's attempt to combat inflation with accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 110), a decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO MoM change < -0.5%) signals an impending slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 110 AND INDPRO MoM change < -0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
